claims: Dunkin' is giving away 1 million free coffees on April 21, 2026, starting at 9 a.m. local time.
Dunkin' Rewards members can use the promo code FREECOFFEE1 in the Dunkin' app to receive a free medium hot or iced coffee
The free coffee offer is available while supplies last
Cold brew and extra-large hot coffees are excluded
Dunkin' Rewards membership is required for the free coffee
The free coffee is limited to one per customer
The promo code is valid for 7 days after redeeming the code
Dunkin's free coffee promotion follows a similar April Fools' Day giveaway
Dunkin's free coffee promotion is part of a series of "ProDUNKtivity" boosts for customers
